sentences: Whenever the selected major axis is ±0.0, `v_cubema_f32` returns `+0.0` (`0x00000000`), never `-0.0` (`0x80000000`), while preserving NaNs and signed non-zero major-axis values (`2.0 * m`).
Emitted as `OpFOrdEqual %bool m %f0` selecting `%f0` over `OpFMul m 2.0`, so `-0.0` maps to `+0.0`, NaN compares false and propagates, and non-zero finite/infinite values double with sign preserved.

Until 2026-11-22 both `tools/rdna2spirv.py` and `tools/f32_fuzz.py` multiplied `m` by `2.0` directly and returned `-0.0` when `z = -0.0` on `(±0.0, ±0.0, -0.0)` (or when `-0.0` was selected alongside NaN axes).

**Measured natively on RDNA2** (`gfx1036`, AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics, Windows driver `32.0.21042.62`, wave32 & wave64, all four MODE combinations `flush`/`keep`/`no_dx10`/`ieee` via `tools/hw_oracle/`): all 8 `(±0.0, ±0.0, ±0.0)` triples, `-v` source negation of `+0.0`, `mul:2`, negative denormals, and `(-0.0, qNaN, qNaN)` returned `0x00000000`, while `(-qNaN, 1.0, 1.0)` returned `0xffc00000` and `(-1.0, qNaN, qNaN)` returned `0xc0000000`.
